title: Mae B. Drops her newest single titled "No Gods, No kings, No Masters (No superman)"
htmlContent:
Chicago-based songwriter and performer Mae B. dropped her newest single titled "No Gods, No Kings, No Masters(No superman), an alternative hip-hop and indie rap song mixed with a touch of R&B that will leave you amazed.

"No Gods, No Kings, No masters(No superman) is an upbeat hip-hop theme that has a string of beautiful sounds and a lovely rendition that is soothing to the ears and will make you move your head to the beats, it has mellow lo-fi beats that make you emotional. This song makes you know that there's no Superman and you can be your own Superman because you don't need any Superman.

Mae B. is a very talented rapper and songwriter and always shows her dexterity. She believes so much that the secret to a healthy mindset is a solid commitment to reality at all costs. Her music is always an outlook on her life and how she sees it, which makes her different from the rest. We had to bring this beautiful piece to our page 

Stream NO Gods, No kings, No Master(No superman) on Spotify.
